title: LightingRenderer
description: A renderer chosen by importing it rather than by naming it. Lighting takes one in place of a `quality` string, and Lighting.quality still reports the plain name afterwards - so a scene asks for a renderer in exactly one place and reads back the same vocabulary everywhere else.
